Alice W: quick q — we hit a config regression in prod, fix is tiny. do we treat as patch (1.4.2) or do an annotated hotpatch tag like v1.4.2+hotfix?
Ben K: patch. semver patch is exactly for backwards-compatible bug fixes. keep it simple.
Carla P: simplest is `v1.4.2` and an entry in release notes: 'config: fix tls handshake for metrics exporter'. avoids weird tag parsing in downstream tooling.
Samir: if we plan a staged holdback (only some customers), canary metadata is handy. e.g. `v1.4.2+canary.202` so infra can route by tag. but npm/packagers ignore build metadata so might be fine.
Maria: two concerns: 1) our release automation (release-bot) currently parses major.minor.patch only. 2) oss consumers might get confused by `+` metadata in tags.
deploy-bot: starting canary deploy for ref:refs/heads/release-1.4 -> tag:v1.4.2 at 2024-11-02T15:02:36Z (3/12 hosts)
Alice W: good point Maria — we should avoid breaking the CI. if release-bot can't handle `+` we need a migration BEFORE we use it.
Ben K: alternative: keep git tag `v1.4.2` and add lightweight tag `hotfix/1.4.2-canary-2024-11-02` or a release note label. that keeps semver pure.
Carla P: +1 for separate branch/tag for rollout. less surprise for package managers. also makes rollback trivial: just delete the lightweight rollout tag or revert branch.
Samir: rollback plan: if canary fails, rollback via `git push -f origin :refs/tags/hotfix/1.4.2-canary-2024-11-02` and trigger deploy-bot rollback. we should document that in release playbook.
Maria: question re pinning: should customers pin to `1.4.x` or exact `1.4.2`? for critical fixes we recommend exact pinning in release notes, otherwise `~1.4.2` could pull unintended changes.
Alice W: release note draft for this thread: "1.4.2 — patch: fix metrics TLS regression; rollout via hotfix branch canary; no public API change. pin to exact patch if you need stable behavior." Any objections?
Ben K: looks fine. add a line about rollback window: 30m canary + 60m slow rollout, then full release.
Carla P: also add tagging convention doc link maybe `docs/releasing.md#hotfixes` so PMs know.
deploy-bot: canary reached 8/12 hosts, latency stable, no errors so far.
Samir: if we adopt the lightweight rollout-tag pattern, let's add a tiny script in ops: `scripts/tag-hotfix.sh` that creates signed annotated tag for the canonical patch and a lightweight `hotfix/*` for rollout metadata.
Maria: decision then: canonical semver tag only uses `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`. rollout metadata lives in `hotfix/` tags or release notes. I'll update release automation ticket to keep `+` out until we support it.
Alice W: agreed. I'll go ahead with `v1.4.2` tag + `hotfix/1.4.2-canary-20241102` branch for rollout, release-note updated, and ping infra to run the tag script. thanks all :thumbsup:
